Payments Architecture : Payments Hub Solution Design

Created by Sample Author, last modified on Mar 12, 2021

1. Business context

This design replaces the branch payment forms with a single Payments Hub. Customers start payments in the Mobile Banking App.

CapabilityDescription
Payment InitiationAccept and validate a customer's instruction to pay
Payment ExecutionSend the payment through the scheme

2. Application architecture

The Payments Hub sends authorised instructions to the Execution Gateway. The Mobile Banking App calls the Payments Hub for every new payment.

ApplicationDescriptionVendorStatus
Payments HubCaptures, validates and authorises payment instructionsin-houseLive
Execution GatewayHands instructions to scheme executionin-houseLive
Fraud ScreeningScores each payment for fraud before releaseVendorCoPlanned
Legacy Payment FormsBranch payment entryin-houseDecommissioned

Source SystemTarget SystemInterfaceProtocol
